claim: gbrain embedding configuration CRITICAL: use Ollama bge-m3 (local, no API key) NOT OpenAI. Provider=openai, model=bge-m3, base_url=http://localhost:11434/v1, api_key=dummy. Matches code-review-graph unified embeddings (same vector space). Session 2026-07-04: fixed 2114+ sync failures by switching from OpenAI (missing OPENAI_API_KEY) to local Ollama.

decisions.notes: gbrain sync repeatedly failed with 'OpenAI embedding requires OPENAI_API_KEY'. Root cause: gbrain config had no embedding provider or was set to OpenAI. Solution: switch to Ollama bge-m3 (same model code-review-graph uses). Unified embeddings = consistent semantic search across both tools. No external API, no rate limits, fast local processing.
